acceptance_scope: Narrow Stage0 prototype per specification section 41; does not accept linked production/MVP features
assertion: Автоматически проверить, что каждый активный FR/subrequirement имеет stage, owner, хотя бы один AC и evidence path; каждый AC ссылается на доступный этап и capability. Проверить невозможные state transition и отсутствие Stage0 dependency на Stage2 Web, отдельное handling UNKNOWN incident.
environment: Disposable GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04.5; Python 3.13 unit/native labs, Python 3.12 QEMU harness; Docker 29.9.3, Compose 2.38.2, age 1.3.2; no user VPS/SSH keys
fault_injection: Delete trace fields; introduce unknown, later-stage or cyclic dependencies, competing graphs and terminal Job return
initial_state: Canonical v2.3 registry with AC-28 stage amendment
limits: Automated self-review, not an independent human security audit.
QEMU guests, managed services and SFTP share one hypervisor; external operator/offline Owner roles are automated fixture processes.
Independent VPS/targets in dependency tests are inventory scopes on the fixture runner, not independently administered production machines.
SIGKILL/ENOSPC phase-boundary injection does not prove physical power-loss or arbitrary filesystem/storage durability.
Backend approval authority and managed root/Docker daemon remain within the stated TCB; knowingly false Owner attestation is not detected with a guarantee.
Lab dependency SBOM is scoped and incomplete for a production release; package install/update/restore integration remains unaccepted.
